node.title: Re: Pasting text when capturing user input only prints one character if system call is made in the loop
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I guess you're still trying to reinvent the [doc://Term::ReadLine] wheel? ;-) In your [id://1233097|previous thread] you said "I am hopping around to different machines frequently ... especially say, a Mac that doesn't have dev tools installed, etc.". [doc://system] calls to local tools isn't what I would call portable. I would recommend, like others have, using a module for this purpose. I might suggest that you could instead look at how to package modules with your scripts so that you don't need to install them everywhere - e.g. [mod://App::FatPacker] or [dist://PAR-Packer].
